title: Lab-book storage
unavailable: The lab-book location could not be loaded.
copyEffect: Copies this lab book with its records, history and files.
exportEffect: Creates a backup you can open using this lab book's password or recovery key.
copyPending: This lab book has an unfinished copy.
exportPending: This lab book has an unfinished backup export.
cancelled: Transfer cancelled. Destination files kept at {path}
movePending: This lab book has an unfinished move.
importEffect: Adds this lab book to the current project, including its records, history and files.
discardImportDetail: The copy created by this import will be removed. Its source folder will be kept.
stopImportDetail: The existing folder and its data will be kept.
